text:
If you cancel today (the 20th), which is before the 25th, the cancellation takes effect for the next box, so you won't be charged the $49 Collector fee on the 25th. There's no cancellation fee or minimum term.

To cancel, go to "Account" > "Subscriptions" and choose cancel. Any box that has already been billed isn't refunded and will still be sent to you. Please make sure you cancel before the 25th, because changes made on or after that date only apply to the following month's box.
